en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Maryam Al Ansary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding

two men who both gathered upon cutting a hand of a man. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he likes he can cut the hand of both of them and pay to them both a wergild of one hand, so it would be divided between the two of them, then cut a hand of both of them; and if he so likes, he can take a wergild from both of them for one hand’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And if he cuts a hand of (just) one of the two, the one who is not cut would have to pay the one who has been cut, a quarter of the wergild’.
